full_name: Hernan del Valle | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Policy & Practice Rita E. Hauser Fellow Doctors Without Borders/Médecins Sans Frontières (Netherlands)
bio: Hernan del Valle has led humanitarian aid operations for the past 15 years. His work has taken him across five continents assisting people affected by armed conflict and forced displacement.
